declared.governing_principle_today: C20 — frame every decision from the loss side first; stop, size and time limit settled before the target is discussed. With prices 15 days stale and three of my five checklist steps unevaluable, the loss side is the only side I can actually measure. Operationally that made C15 (no stop, no size, no trade) the day's first and largest filter, and it is why the conviction ceiling on this sheet is 3, not 5: C3's full five-condition set-up could not be confirmed on a single name, so no name earns full conviction.

The packet offers ma_50, ma_100 and ma_200; C1 states plainly that no 50, 100 or 200 period average is this author's, and silently swapping ma_50 in for ma_40 would re-create exactly the error the canon extraction found.
